ety.hint: The words 口 of a scholar 士

origin.says: Early forms put a tablet or weapon-like object (later written 士) over 口 (mouth, a container); the exact sense is disputed. It means lucky, auspicious. The top changed into 士 (scholar) early on.

喊.def: to shout, to yell, to call out; to howl; to cry

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 咸 (all) as the sound: to shout with the mouth.

喊.name: yell

ety.hint: Water 氵 from the eyes 目

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 目 (eye): water from the eye, tears. An old popular form that replaced 淚 (water + 戾 as the sound).

扬.def: to flutter, to wave; to hoist, to raise; to praise

origin.says: Simplified from 揚: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunlit) as the sound: to raise up high, to wave. 昜 is written in its cursive shape 𠃓.

扬.name: raise high

ety.hint: Simplified form of 喪; to cry 哭 over the dead 亡

origin.says: From 喪: many mouths 口 (mouth) crying around a mulberry tree 桑 (mulberry), which gave the sound; later 亡 (die) was added. The simplified form is a cursive shorthand whose parts no longer show the build.

惩.def: to discipline, to punish, to reprimand, to warn

origin.says: Simplified from 懲: 徵 (summon) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning, to punish so the heart learns. The new form uses 征 (campaign) as a simpler sound part.

惩.name: discipline

祷.def: to pray, to entreat, to beg; prayer

origin.says: 礻 (altar, spirits) for the meaning plus 寿 (long life) as the sound: to pray. Simplified from 禱 with 壽 shortened to 寿.

祷.name: prayer

掩.def: to cover up (with a hand); to ambush, to conceal; to shut

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 奄 (to cover) as the sound, which also helps the meaning: to cover up with the hand, to hide.

掩.name: cover up

捐.def: to give, to donate; to give up, to renounce

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 肙 (small worm) as the sound: to let go of by hand, to give up; then to donate.

捐.name: donate

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 前 (front) as the sound: an arrow, made from a kind of bamboo.

拯.def: to aid, to help; to lift, to raise

ety.hint: To give 丞 a hand 扌; 丞 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 丞 (to lift up, help) for the sound and meaning: to lift someone out, to rescue.

拯.name: lift out

辖.def: to control, to have jurisdiction; the linchpin of a wheel

origin.says: Simplified from 轄: 車 (cart) for the meaning plus 害 as the sound: the linchpin that holds a cart's wheel, hence to control, to have under one's command. 車 is written 车.

辖.name: linchpin

origin.says: Simplified from 籃: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 監 (supervise) as the sound: a bamboo basket; now also a basketball hoop. It uses the simplified 监.

Bronze forms show 幺 (tiny thread) with a long curved stroke drawn out of its top; the stroke later came loose, giving today's shape. Its first meaning is unknown; one view sees a variant of 玄 (dark, mysterious). The old idea of 予 (give) turned around is a misreading.

ety.hint: Earthen 土 walls built for defense 保; 保 also provides the meaning

origin.says: 保 (to protect) as the sound and meaning plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: earthen walls that protect, a fort.
车 (chariot) for the meaning plus 非 as the sound: chariots set out in ranks, hence a rank, a generation. Simplified from 輩, with 車 shortened to 车.
羽 (feathers) for the meaning plus 異 (different) as the sound: wings.
禺 (monkey-like creature) as the sound plus 心 (heart, mind) for the meaning: a dull mind, foolish, stupid.

塑.def: to sculpt, to model in clay; plastic

origin.says: 朔 (new moon) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: to model figures from clay; now also plastic.

塑.name: clay model

ety.hint: A couple 寿; 寿 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 倆: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 兩 (two) as the sound, a contraction of 兩個 (two of them). 兩 was shortened to 两.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 敖 (roam) as the sound: a proud, haughty person.

欺.def: to cheat, to double-cross, to deceive

origin.says: 其 (basket) as the sound plus 欠 (open mouth, breath): to deceive, to cheat, to bully.

欺.name: deceive

删.def: to delete; to cut; to censor

ety.hint: To cut 刂 out passages from a book 册

origin.says: Bamboo slips tied together 册 (book) and a knife 刂 (knife): scraping or cutting text off the slips, to delete.

删.name: delete

斤.def: a catty (about 500 grams); an axe; keen, shrewd

origin.says: A picture of an axe with a handle. It was borrowed as a unit of weight, the catty (about half a kilo).

斤.name: axe
斤.in: 所新听近断斯析渐兵折暂哲欣祈滨宾晰逝薪誓斩掀崭撕匠惭斧芹浙缤嘶鬓

祈.def: to pray, to entreat, to beseech

origin.says: 礻 (altar, spirits) for the meaning plus 斤 (axe) as the sound: asking the spirits, to pray.

祈.name: pray

ety.hint: A man 亻 being hit 夂 on the head 囟

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus an old character for the fontanelle, the soft top of the head (here 囟 skull over 八 and 夂): a person soft in the head, foolish. Whether the right part also gave the sound is not stated.

琴.def: Chinese lute or guitar, string instrument

ety.hint: Two guitar strings 玨 suggest the meaning; 今 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: The top is a drawing of a stringed zither, now looking like two 王 (king), plus 今 (now) below as the sound: a zither, now any string instrument or piano.

琴.name: zither

origin.says: 户 (door) as the sound plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) for the meaning: first the name of a bird; 'to hire' is a sound loan.

辅.def: side road; to assist, to coach, to tutor

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 甫 (just now) as the sound: the side boards that strengthen a cart, hence to help, to assist. Simplified from 輔 with the short cart form.

辅.name: tutor

origin.says: Origin unsettled: the favoured reading sees a rope being thrown out to pull with, the first form of 扔 (throw); another sees a woman seen from the side with breasts, the first form of 奶 (milk). Borrowed early as a function word, 'then, indeed; your'.

乃.name: and then
乃.in: 仍透秀奶孕盈扔携诱绣锈

ety.hint: To dig out 扌 a hollow 穵; 穵 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 穵 (to hollow out) as the sound: to dig.

寄.def: to mail, to send, to transit; to deposit, to entrust; to rely on

origin.says: 宀 (house) for the meaning plus 奇 (strange) as the sound: living in someone else's house, then to entrust something to others, and to send by mail.

寄.name: lodge

ety.hint: The mouth 乚 of a crying baby 子

origin.says: 子 (child) with a mark 乚 at the head: the opening in a baby's skull, so a hole, opening; also the surname of Confucius.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: water wrapped round air, a bubble.
Simplified from 爛: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 闌 as the sound, replaced by 兰: cooked to mush, overripe, rotten.

钻.def: diamond; to bore, to drill, to pierce

origin.says: Simplified from 鑽: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 贊 (praise) as the sound, a metal awl, to drill. The simplified form is 钅 (metal) plus 占 (divine) as a simpler sound part.

钻.name: diamond

origin.says: A picture of a snake or worm. It also replaced 蟲 (three 虫 worms, 'insects'), so the old snake character now means insect or bug.

虫.name: bug
虫.in: 强虽独融蛋触蠢蛇骚蛮烛虾蚀蜡蜜蝶蝴蛛蜘虹蜂蟹蚁蚂蛙蜀螃蚊蜗蜕蚪蝌茧蟋蟀蚓蚯浊蛀蛾蚕搔蚤闽蚌蚣萤蜓蜒蛤蜈蜻蝇蝉蝠蝎蝗蝙蟆螺

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: first a variant meaning to cross water (a raft, a ford); now the city name Hangzhou.

邪.def: wrong, evil, demonic; perverse, depraved, heterodox

origin.says: 阝 (town) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound: first part of a place name, later borrowed for 'wrong, evil'.

邪.name: wicked

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: a sound from the mouth, vomiting, a baby's cry, or a cry of surprise.

蹈.def: to dance, to stamp the feet

origin.says: 足 (foot) for the meaning plus 舀 (scoop) as the sound: to tread, stamp the feet, dance.

蹈.name: tread

摩.def: to scour, to rub, to grind; friction

origin.says: 手 (hand) for the meaning plus 麻 (hemp) as the sound: to rub with the hand.

摩.name: rub hands

ety.hint: A hand with a dot indicating where the pulse can be felt, about an inch up the wrist

origin.says: A hand with a short stroke marking a spot on the wrist (or elbow), used for a small unit of length, the inch. One reading says it marks the pulse point, another the elbow.

寸.name: inch
寸.in: 对时过得等将持特府导待村讨谢付博射寻附守封尊树诗符碍冠腐夺遵寺祷厨耐辱慰筹寿薄傅蒋畴衬涛缚爵搏蹲咐铸膊侍俯橱嚼蔚簿褥肘恃

origin.says: Simplified from 喬, a form of 高 (tall) with a mark added on top (later written 夭, a bending person) to make a separate word: tall, lofty. The simplified form keeps 夭 and shortens the rest.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 同 (same) as the sound: a hollow worn by water, a cave or hole, hence piercing through.

姿.def: grace, good looks; bearing, poise, posture

origin.says: 次 (next) as the sound plus 女 (woman) for the meaning: a graceful bearing, looks, posture.

姿.name: posture

origin.says: An old variant used as the simplified form of 傑 (亻 person + 桀 as the sound: an outstanding person). Its shape, 木 (tree) over 灬 (fire), does not show that build.

迁.def: to shift, to move; to transfer, to change

origin.says: Simplified from 遷 (move, shift), whose upper part is unclear, with 辶 (walk). The simplified form keeps 辶 (walk) and uses 千 (thousand) as the sound.

迁.name: relocate

剂.def: dose; medicine; measure word for medicines

origin.says: From 劑: 齊 (even) as the sound and hint plus 刂 (knife) for the meaning: cutting into even portions, a dose. The simplified form uses 齐 (even).

剂.name: dose

ety.hint: Simplified form of 麦; grains 來 ready to be harvested 夂

origin.says: Simplified from 麥: 來 (a drawing of a wheat plant) on top of 夂 (foot), whose role is unclear. The simplified form shortens 來 to a 龶-like top.

跌.def: to stumble, to slip, to fall

ety.hint: To lose 失 one's footing 足

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 失 (lose) as the sound: to lose one's footing, to stumble and fall; also prices falling.

跌.name: stumble

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 禺 (monkey-like creature) as the sound: to lodge under a roof, a residence; also to imply, as in a fable.

唐.def: the Tang dynasty; Chinese; empty, exaggerated; surname

ety.hint: Children learning how to read 口 and write 肀 in school 广

origin.says: 庚 (flail) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: boastful talk; later the Tang dynasty and 'Chinese'. The top of 庚 merged into 广 (shelter) plus a hand shape.

唐.name: tang

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound: fine and delicate, so wonderful, clever.
A picture of fired earthenware, perhaps interlocking roof tiles; another reading sees a potter's tool.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 弟 (younger brother, sequence) as the sound: a wooden ladder, steps in order.

Read by tradition as two 贝 (shells), a shell necklace, over 女 (woman): a woman's neck ornament, later a baby held at the breast. One reading sees a sound part instead. Simplified from 嬰 by the short 贝.
尸 (body) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: to cut up a carcass, to slaughter.

抛.def: to abandon, to throw away; to fling, to toss

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus a sound part made of 九 (nine, once 尢, lame) over 力 (strength): to throw away, to fling. One old dictionary also reads the parts as hand, 尢 (lame) and strength together.

抛.name: fling

磨.def: millstone; to grind, to polish, to rub, to wear out

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus a sound part: one reading says a shortened 靡 (scatter), which now looks like 麻 (hemp). A stone that grinds: millstone, to grind, to wear down.

磨.name: millstone

origin.says: 又 (hand) plus 尗 (a wooden stake) as the sound and meaning: a hand planting a stake, digging. Borrowed for its sound to mean a father's younger brother. The stake's modern shape looks like 上 (up) over 小 (small).

ety.hint: A place 阝 wedged in a valley 夹

origin.says: Simplified from 陝: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 㚒 (shǎn) as the sound; the simplified form writes 㚒 as the look-alike 夹 (squeeze). A pass squeezed between hills, now the name of Shaanxi.

曝.def: to air out, to expose to sunlight; to reveal

origin.says: 暴 once meant 'to dry in the sun'; 日 (sun) was added to keep that sense apart: to expose to sunlight.

曝.name: sun-dry

ety.hint: A container 凵 of wickedness 乂

origin.says: 凵 (pit) with a cross mark inside: a trap or hole in the ground, a place of danger, hence ominous, fierce, evil. Whether the cross is a mark or stakes in the pit is disputed.

凶.name: death pit
凶.in: 离胸璃匈酗禽篱汹漓擒

沿.def: to follow a course, to go along

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 㕣 (marsh mouth) as the sound: to go along a river, along the edge.

沿.name: along the bank

ety.hint: A building 广 containing an altar 由

origin.says: Simplified from 廟: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 朝 (court) as the sound: the ancestral temple. The simplified form replaces 朝 with 由.

ety.hint: A bear's 能 footprints 灬

origin.says: The bear was first written 能 (able), a drawing of the animal. When 能 was borrowed for 'able', the bear got a new form: 能 with four dots below. Shuowen reads the dots as a shortened 炎 (blaze) for the sound; others as legs or a mere added mark.

堆.def: crowd, heap, pile, mass; to pile up; measure word for things in piles or stacks

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: a heap of earth, a pile.

堆.name: heap

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 与 (with) as the sound: a small mountain in the sea, an island. Simplified from 嶼 by replacing 與 with 与.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 勿 (do not) as the sound: the lips, to kiss.

脉.def: a pulse; arteries, veins; blood vessels

ety.hint: Long 永 vessels through one's body ⺼

origin.says: Variant of 脈: ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 𠂢 (branching streams, pài) as the sound: the branching veins, the pulse. In 脉 the right side is written like 永 (long).

脉.name: pulse

origin.says: Simplified from 廚: 广 (building) for the meaning plus 尌 as the sound: the room where food is made. The standard took an old variant with 厂 (cliff shelter) on top.

ety.hint: Difficult 难 waters 氵 to navigate; 难 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 灘: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 難 (difficult) as the sound: rapids, sandbank. 難 became 难, with 又 (hand) in place of its left part.

ety.hint: The time of year when farmers would burn 禾 crops 火

origin.says: Early forms draw a cricket or locust, sometimes over fire, the insect of autumn. Later it was rebuilt as 禾 (grain) with a shortened sound part that looks like 火 (fire), often read as burning stubble after the harvest.

ety.hint: A point, small 小 over big 大

origin.says: 小 (small) over 大 (big): a thing that goes from small at the top to big at the bottom, a point. Hence sharp, pointed.
Simplified from 膽: ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 詹 (talkative) as the sound, the gallbladder, seat of courage. The new form takes 旦 (dawn) as a simpler sound part.

泄.def: drip, leak, vent; to disperse; to reduce

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 世 (generation) as the sound: water leaking or draining out; to let out, to vent.

泄.name: leak

origin.says: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 今 (now, perhaps "open mouth") as the sound: greedy for wealth. Simplified from 貪 by the cursive shell 贝.
